Title: Retrieve the first page of all areas with default pagination settings
Preconditions: At least one area exists in the system
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/areas with no query parameters.
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains a paginated list of areas (default 10 items) with fields 'id' and 'name', along with pagination metadata including 'totalElements', 'totalPages', 'size', and 'number'.

Title: Retrieve the first page of areas filtered by name with default pagination settings
Section: Area Management - Paginated Retrieval by Name
Preconditions: At least one area with name 'Downtown' exists in the system
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/areas?name=Downtown with no pagination parameters.
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains a paginated list of areas (default 10 items) where the 'name' field matches 'Downtown', along with pagination metadata including 'totalElements', 'totalPages', 'size', and 'number'.

Title: Retrieve a specific page of all areas with custom page size
Preconditions: At least 15 areas exist in the system
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/areas?page=1&size=5.
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains a paginated list of exactly 5 areas (page 1, size 5) with fields 'id' and 'name', along with pagination metadata confirming 'size' as 5, 'number' as 1, and correct 'totalElements' and 'totalPages'.

Title: API endpoints accept requests from any origin without CORS errors
Preconditions: The API is running and accessible

Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response headers include 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' with a value matching the request's 'Origin' header, and 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' set to 'true'.
